direction_authority: NOAA technical note 329 (2016), section 2.6 standard outputs: meteorological FROM direction. Source check at 42002 2024-10-07 00Z gives native GRIB 49.8 deg versus station spectrum 40.4 deg; adding 180 is wrong. The older EMC web product page describes an older oceanographic convention.
period_authority: NOAA technical note 329 (2016), partition output PTP is peak period. WVPER/SWPER GRIB labels use legacy mean-period names. Station source check separates peak period (~6.9 s) from Tm01 (~5.36 s).
partition_direction_caveat: Partition directions are partition MEAN FROM in the source, used as the unimodal reconstruction centre. They are not an independently observed within-partition peak direction.
